title: Playing Custom Game file upload
description: sandbox media player that bypasses the technical limitations of standard platforms like GN Math. Users upload game files. It would convert uploaded files into temporary local browser links, and it uses zero server bandwidth while allowing students taking computer science or game design classes to instantly test their own custom game exports from engines like Unity, Godot, Twine, or Construct 3 directly within your site.  More importantly and beyond testing student-developed projects, this would be a workaround for playing high-demand retro console emulators, heavy arcade clones, and modded game packs that frequently get taken down or fail to run on static Google Sites infrastructures (like what GNmath is). And, by integrating a modern JavaScript emulator like Ruffle.js into the upload box, your site could also be unique hub in that it would be able to launch thousands of classic legacy Flash games that u cannot play on school computers
creator: ngo_89
